newsitem.title: USA: Sylvan Learning buys language instructor.
newsitem.headline: Sylvan Learning buys language instructor.

text.p: Sylvan Learning Systems Inc said on Thursday it has agreed to buy privately held Wall Street Institute International, a European based franchisor and operator of centers that teach English, for $26 million in cash and stock.

With more than 170 franchised centers in operation throughout Europe and Latin America, Wall Street Institute had revenues of approximately $13 million for the fiscal year ended August 31, 1996, Sylvan said.
Sylvan said $2.5 million of the purchase price will be paid in cash and the remainder in stock.
The acquisition, which is anticipated to close by the end of January, is expected to be minimally accretive to fiscal 1997 earnings, Sylvan said.
